name: Water Chestnuts
siboNotes: Water chestnuts are naturally low FODMAP and well-tolerated in SIBO diets. Their crisp texture adds bulk without fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Fresh water chestnuts should be peeled before use
Canned water chestnuts are pre-peeled and ready to use - rinse before adding to dishes
Add to stir-fries at the end to maintain their signature crunch
Can be eaten raw in salads for extra texture
nutritionalHighlights: High in potassium for heart health
Good source of fiber for digestive health
